Name: Rule 1: every measure has a description and a format string
Description: A measure without a description cannot say which definition it implements, and one without a format string renders raw numbers. A dynamic format string (formatStringDefinition) counts as a format string.

Name: Rule 2: a measure called Revenue, Sales or Total Revenue must name its definition
Description: Revenue on its own is ambiguous. A measure named or translated as plain Revenue, Sales or Total Revenue (any case, surrounding spaces ignored) fails unless its description starts with a definition ID, a spaced dash and the definition, e.g. 'R3 — Board revenue: ...'. An em dash, en dash or hyphen is accepted.
Expression: (RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)^\s*(revenue|sales|total\s+revenue)\s*$") or TranslatedNames.Any(it != null and RegEx.IsMatch(it, "(?i)^\s*(revenue|sales|total\s+revenue)\s*$"))) and (string.IsNullOrWhitespace(Description) or not RegEx.IsMatch(Description, "^\S+\s+[—–-]\s+\S"))

Name: Rule 3: no bidirectional relationships
Description: Filters flow from dimension to fact only. Bidirectional cross-filtering creates ambiguous paths and can change totals silently.

Name: Rule 4: key columns are hidden and summarizeBy none
Description: A key column is one whose name ends in Key or that takes part in a relationship (date-typed columns excepted, so a marked date table's Date column stays visible). Keys must be hidden (column or table) and must not summarize.
Expression: (Name.EndsWith("Key") or UsedInRelationships.Any()) and DataType <> "DateTime" and ((not IsHidden and not Table.IsHidden) or SummarizeBy <> "None")

Name: Rule 5: a date table is marked
Description: The model needs one table marked as a date table: dataCategory Time and a date-typed key column. Fiscal-year time intelligence depends on it.
Expression: not Tables.Any(DataCategory = "Time" and Columns.Any(IsKey and DataType = "DateTime"))

Name: Rule 6: every visible measure is in a display folder
Description: Visible measures are grouped in display folders (Revenue, Margin, ...) so the field list stays readable. Reported as a warning: it does not change a number.
Expression: not IsHidden and not Table.IsHidden and string.IsNullOrWhitespace(DisplayFolder)
